Field.Name: Source
Field.Description: The source of the order. Typically the account of the OUCH port used to enter the order, but can also have the special value "$PHON " for orders received via the phone desk.

Field.Name: User
Field.Description: The free form User field as specified by the order entry firm when the order was entered.

Field.Name: Token
Field.Description: The free form Token field as specified by the order entry firm when the order was entered.

Field.Name: Replaced Token
Field.Description: The free form Token field as specified by the order entry firm when the order was entered. Only used on a replaced message.

Field.Name: Buy Sell
Field.Description: The side of the trade executed.

Field.Name: Shares
Field.Description: For a new order accept, the total number of shares entered; for a cancel, the incremental number of shares canceled; for an execution, the incremental number of shares executed in this trade; for a broken execution, the number of shares in the previously transmitted execution.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: For a new order accepted, the limit price of the order; for an execution, the execution price; for a cancel, the limit price of the open order.

Field.Name: Reference
Field.Description: The order unique reference number assigned by Nasdaq to this order.

Field.Name: Time In Force
Field.Description: On messages other than executions and breaks the Match field carries the order's Time in Force (TIF).

Field.Name: Capacity
Field.Description: The capacity as specified by the order entry firm.

Field.Name: Liquidity Code
Field.Description: For execution messages, the liquidity code value.

Field.Name: Clearing Code
Field.Description: The clearing path this trade will take.
